target: the formula -> serovar-NAME lookup, not the antigen calling
why_this_target: After the O-procedure port, 13 of the 14 remaining misses carry a formula BYTE-IDENTICAL to SeqSero2's. The antigen axes now agree; what diverges is the name lookup. The registry's standing line that 'the formula lookup is not the problem' was true when the O axis dominated and is now stale.

diagnosed_cause.first_wins_dedup: scripts/build_salmserovar_db.py::build_table keys on (O,H1,H2) and keeps the FIRST serovar per key. Measured against SeqSero2's own lists: 2578 entries -> 2365 distinct formulas, 195 formulas carry >1 serovar, 213 serovars are SILENTLY DISCARDED. Its comment claims 'subspecies-I named serovars come first'; that is FALSIFIED by the data -- for 16:b:e,n,x the first entry is the UNNAMED subspecies-II formula and the named Hvittingfoss is second. Cubana, Muenchen and Hvittingfoss are absent from our table entirely.
diagnosed_cause.four_dropped_mechanisms: SeqSero2's own naming code (SeqSero2_package.py ~L286-380) uses (1) remove_list to exclude entries, (2) rename_dict, (3) bracket EXPANSION so 'r,[i]' matches a bare 'r' (this is the Bovismorbificans/Hindmarsh collision), (4) a subspecies filter. build_table applies none of them.

actionable_set.definition: isolates where our formula EQUALS SeqSero2's profile, SeqSero2 is right and we are not

accuracy_denominator: ALL 200 cohort isolates. Accuracy means WET-LAB-LABEL accuracy, never agreement with SeqSero2.
clauses_are_DIRECTIONAL_not_net: A net count cannot separate laundering from rescue. The 2026-09-09 O-port bar failed on a NET no_call ceiling by one isolate while the change was strictly dominant, and shipping it required a recorded override. Every clause below is written on per-isolate TRANSITIONS instead.
adopt_if_ALL_hold: hits rise by >= +4 over the baseline 165 on the fixed 200-isolate denominator
ZERO regressions: the hit->miss transition count is 0
ZERO regressions: the hit->no_call transition count is 0
confident errors do not increase: miss count <= 14
H1 and H2 agreement with SeqSero2 do not fall below baseline (this change must not touch the antigen axes at all)
deliberately_absent: any NET no_call ceiling -- a multi-valued name table can legitimately convert a formerly-unique-by-accident call into an honest abstention, and the hit->no_call clause already forbids the harmful direction
explicitly_not_a_success_signal: recovering a name by picking a different arbitrary winner from an ambiguous formula
any improvement measured on a denominator restricted to post-change resolved rows
agreement with SeqSero2 used as the accuracy metric
